hbpArea.source: City of Vancouver, Higher Buildings Policy (amended through 31 Mar 2026), https://guidelines.vancouver.ca/policy-higher-buildings-for-rezonings.pdf, s.2.1(c), as read by research packets C01/C03/P02/P05 (Oct 2026); Figure 1 is an image and was never read; City of Vancouver, Higher Buildings Policy Review FAQ, https://www.shapeyourcity.ca/higher-buildings/widgets/224666/faqs (opened 6 Nov 2026)
hbpArea.note: Not confirmed. The policy text puts the tallest CBD buildings (about 700 ft) on West Georgia, Burrard or Granville; this block fronts Granville. The City FAQ places the Bay Parkade block (Georgia/Dunsmuir/Seymour/Richards) OUTSIDE the area and 'sites immediately across the street' INSIDE it; this block is two blocks from the Bay Parkade (diagonally across Granville and Dunsmuir from the Hudson's Bay block), so the FAQ does not settle it. A person must read Figure 1 of the policy PDF (HTTP 403 to scripts; not bypassed).
